purpose: Judge two related people or things as equally characteristic.
keywords: N1 + が / も … なら、N2 + も … だ
The manager is just as unhelpful as the staff.
The younger brother is just as stubborn as the older one.
formation: N1 + が / も … なら、N2 + も … だ
restrictions: Parallel evaluations usually reinforce one another.
mistake: Both halves need a matching evaluative relationship.
